text:
Being in want of milk, I caught up my keys and drove to the shop, which I found extremely crowded; and a man in a coat drawn over his head, who stood talking to a distant person by means of a little instrument in his hand, had stopped the whole passage.

I did not wish to be rude, and begged him to excuse me; but he disregarded me entirely, and it was long before he moved, and I was able to get my milk. I saw at the counter a woman with whom I had formerly been connected, and was exceedingly terrified.

"How do you do?" said she. "It is a great while since we met; you look extremely well."

"I thank you," said I, "and you also." I paid and left as fast as I could; it was, I declare, the most awkward ten minutes of my week.
